"""Week 2 config (day 14). Strategy: scale proven S1 funnel modestly, keep S2 quality build, hold R&D/research pending retention+S2 data."""
import novamind_api as nm

# --- Ads: concentrate on content_marketing (143 leads/$1k, 3x best). FULL budget (replaces). ---
nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={
    "content_marketing": {"S1": 600.0},   # up from 400; best channel
    "social_media":      {"S1": 100.0},   # small diversification (down from 150)
    # search_ads dropped (least efficient ~59/1k); all S2/S3/linkedin = 0
})

# --- Lead promo: keep S1 $8 (effective $6 -> 9.3% conv). Clean retention test this cohort. ---
nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(global_promotion=0.0, by_group={"S1": 8.0})

# --- Dev: keep global $1500 (S1 retention + broad quality) + targeted S2 $2000 (open ~wk6-7). ---
nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=250.0, development=1500.0)  # ops up 150->250 (resolve 8 issues, cut outage risk)
nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={"S2": 2000.0})

# --- ads_strength 0 (in-app ads cut quality; quality is the moat). ---
nm.marketing.set_ads_strength(global_strength=0.0)

# Prices/tiers/quotas/capacity unchanged (A=14/T2/q200, B=59/T3/q450, C=129/T4/q900, capacity T0).
# HOLD R&D + market research this week (preserve cash; decide once retention[~wk5] + S2[~wk7] confirmed).

print("Week 2 config applied.")
# Verify live state
ci = nm.infrastructure.get_cost_info()
print("capacity tier:", ci.get('current_tier', ci.get('tier','?')))
